title: Goldman Sachs brings $100 billion Treasury fund into crypto’s institutional plumbing
summary: The bank is bringing its roughly $100 billion Treasury fund to institutional crypto firms without creating a tokenized version of it.

title: The restaking gold rush is over, and top protocols are barely making a profit
summary: As restaking yields dried up and smart-contract risks mounted, Ethereum's top liquid restaking protocol walked away from its core business to build a crypto neobank instead.

title: Tether is a ‘lifeline’ for Iranian regime, Senate Dems say in new report
summary: Democrats on the Senate's Permanent Subcommittee on Intelligence published a report alleging that USDT had become a key tool for the Iranian government.

title: AI agents could drain cheap bank deposits, Apollo's Torsten Slok warns
summary: AI agents could trigger a bank run by automatically moving household cash from low-interest checking accounts to higher-yield alternatives, Slok warns.

title: Chainlink launches new version of its crypto bridge tech 'CCIP' to give apps more control over their security
summary: The new software lets companies add custom security checks so they do not fall victim to the same type of vulnerabilities that plagued rival bridges.
